jobs.occupation: Marketing Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule) - Marketing)
jobs.description: ?‍?‍About the roleOnly four years after entering the market, Mondu is one of Europe’s leading B2B payments providers. Now live across 30+ markets, trusted by ambitious companies, and operating with an EMI license, we’re expanding our commercial footprint in Europe and beyond.We are now looking for a Marketing Manager to own the marketing engine that brings new merchants onto our platform. As the function owner, you’ll set the strategy, run the execution, and decide where external support adds the most value. Working closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success, you’ll turn our value proposition into campaigns that generate qualified pipeline, and you’ll be accountable for how much of it converts. This is a hands-on role with real budget responsibility and a direct line to our growth targets.? What you’ll do• Plan and run multi-channel acquisition campaigns that generate qualified merchant pipeline: across email, content (blog posts, case studies optimized for SEO and GEO), LinkedIn, newsletters, and events ranging from intimate small-scale experiences to large exhibition booths.• Partner with Sales to define ICPs, build account-based programs for priority merchant segments (e.g. direct mail campaigns), and improve lead-to-opportunity conversion• Turn complex payments and BNPL products into clear, compelling messaging for finance leaders, e-commerce managers, and founders• Build and optimize nurture journeys and landing pages, running structured A/B tests to lift conversion at every funnel stage.• Work closely with Customer Success to run client initiatives that drive upsell and retention.• Launch joint campaigns with external partners that deliver real business impact• Manage and grow our presence on review platforms such as G2 and Trustpilot• Own campaign budgets and reporting: track CAC, pipeline contribution, and ROI, and shift spend based on what the data tells you• Bring new ideas to the table and test them fast; from bold campaign headlines and concepts, to fresh formats. Continually search for the next big move that sets Mondu apart in B2B payments.?What you need to succeed• B2B experience: 3+ years of B2B marketing experience with a clear focus on growth, demand generation, or customer acquisition. Ideally in FinTech, payments, SaaS, or e-commerce.• Strong Results: A track record of owning campaigns end to end and showing their impact on pipeline and revenue, not just impressions.• Autonomous: you’re self-directed, set your own priorities, and actively seek out external perspectives, whether from agencies, peer networks, or the marketing community, to sharpen your thinking.• Level-headed: the ability to hold your own while advising our most senior leaders on marketing campaigns that actually work.• AI-first mindset: Strong analytical skills and comfort working with marketing automation and CRM tools (e.g. Claude, HubSpot, Salesforce).• Writing aptitude: Sharp, concise writing and the ability to make technical financial products easy to understand• A startup mindset: you prioritize ruthlessly, move fast, and take ownership when things aren’t defined yet• Communication: Business fluent English; German is a strong plus for the DACH marketIt would be a plus if you also:• Familiarity with BNPL, B2B payment terms, or merchant financing products? What's in it for you?• Strong growth opportunity. This position has the space to grow into the Head of Marketing for a driven and motivated candidate!• Real ownership of the marketing function and the autonomy to test, learn, and scale what works.• € 1000 per year for you to contribute to your learning & development to help you grow professionally and personally.• €300 per year for you to endorse team build, including dinners, games, and events.• 28 vacation days per year (increasing 1 day every year up to 30).• We welcome you to our office in the center of Berlin 3+ days a week.• Take advantage of our Workation policy, allowing for up to 6 weeks every year of work outside of Germany (some restrictions apply).• Subsidised gym membership to boost your physical and mental well-being.• €54 per month towards the DeutschlandTicket• Tax relief for payments into our Business Bike scheme.• Accelerate your career and take ownership of your work and development in a flat hierarchy where 360 feedback is encouraged.? Are you a Monduneer in disguise?Working in a truly diverse group makes us stronger and more resilient. Furthermore, it enables an unfair advantage - the opportunity to learn from each other, see different perspectives, and consider a broader range of variables in our decision-making. That is what being a Monduneer is all about.Thus, regardless of your background, age, disability, gender, parental status, race, religion, sexual orientation, educational background, or any other aspect you feel is a statement of your diversity, we look forward to discussing your role in mind.If you believe you are a Monduneer in disguise, and it's time for you to shine, submit your application, and we'll take it from there.? Meet MonduMondu is changing the B2B payments ecosystem by providing payment solutions that enable any B2B company to grow quickly and safely. We envision a future where businesses, not just consumers, experience a seamless, modern, and human-centered payment flow. Founded by a dream team of passionate entrepreneurs and seasoned tech leaders, Mondu is rapidly scaling. In just four years, we've secured over $120 million in funding, attained an e-money banking license through the Dutch National Bank, and assembled a talented team of over 100 Monduneers across our three locations of Berlin, Amsterdam and London. On the road, we have successfully launched numerous products accessible to buyers in +30 markets - and counting!Our products bring B2B payments up to par with B2C payments: putting the people behind the business at the heart of the payme

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As an Electrical Engineer (f/m/d) for Auxiliary Power Systems, you will plan and engineer electrical supply systems for complex Grid Technologies projects, including HVDC, FACTS, and synchronous condenser installations. You will develop and implement technical concepts from the bid phase through commissioning, ensuring a reliable auxiliary power supply in line with technical, quality, and safety requirements. Working closely with project management, customers, suppliers, and engineering interfaces, you will contribute to the delivery of robust and cost-effective solutions.How You’ll Make an Impact * Planning, design, and engineering of auxiliary power systems, including medium- and low-voltage distribution, transformers, emergency diesel generators, and AC/DC power supply systems* Development and review of power supply concepts, electrical load lists, technical specifications, calculations, and power balance analyses* Coordination of technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, and multidisciplinary engineering teams, including automation, mechanical engineering, and building services* Ensuring compliance with project requirements, applicable standards, safety regulations, and technical documentation requirements* Technical evaluation of supplier bids and documentation, as well as support for factory testing, acceptance testing, and commissioning activities* Support of bid preparation and project execution through technical concept development, cost estimation, risk and opportunity management, and timely delivery of engineering work packages to the required quality standardsWhat You Bring* University degree in Electrical Engineering or a comparable technical qualification* Professional experience in the planning and engineering of auxiliary power systems for turnkey projects, ideally including bid and proposal activities* Strong expertise in medium- and low-voltage systems, transformers, DC systems, protection concepts, and cable dimensioning, as well as proficiency in relevant engineering and calculation tools* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English within international project environments* Structured, independent, and solution-oriented working approach, combined with strong teamwork and stakeholder management skills* Willingness to travel for project-related activities, including technical coordination, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and commissioning supportAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. jobs.occupation: Senior Service Designer, Food Systems & Fulfillment (f/m/x) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
jobs.description: At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The roleThe Enterprise UX practice at HelloFresh is a cross-functional team that brings physical and digital product and service experiences to life through strategic research, service design, prototyping, and storytelling. We are dedicated to transforming enterprise ways of working by applying structured methods like Definition Sprints, Service Blueprinting, and AS-IS and TO-BE mapping, creating meaningful & effective enterprise experiences to shape the future of HelloFresh’s Supply Chain.As a Senior Service Designer, you will leverage your research and service design expertise to shape compelling visions for both product and process improvements. You will deeply investigate current ways of working—identifying key data archetypes, mapping AS-IS states, and collaboratively defining desired TO-BE workflows. Your insights will identify the most impactful opportunities for investment. You will closely collaborate with product, engineering, users and operational stakeholders to design, prototype, and validate scalable solutions aligned with our Enterprise Design System.About the DomainThe wider Food Systems Alliance owns technology that enables a lean and sustainable procurement process from Suppliers to HelloFresh facilities and improves customer experience with accurate ingredient data flow and optimal ingredient quality. Optimising cost of ingredients, providing customers with the freshest and best ingredients, and enabling buying decisions that reduce excess stock and other forms of inventory waste are just some of the focus areas for this alliance.What you’ll do- Conduct and lead strategic Definition Sprints to uncover user needs, validate hypotheses, and collaboratively define clear next steps for design and development.- Map current (AS-IS) enterprise processes and systems, identifying pain points and opportunities, then collaboratively design optimized (TO-BE) processes, particularly within the Food Systems alliance  - the cluster that takes care of supply chain management topics within Hello Fresh..- Partner and inspire other enterprise designers to excel in service design and prototyping, nurturing growth within the team.- Deeply understand the user journeys and workflows of Recipe Developers, Menu Planners, and Buyers, building strong stakeholder relationships to advocate effectively for these users.- Develop and align design concepts and prototypes with the Enterprise Design System to ensure scalability and consistency across enterprise tooling.- Form collaborative partnerships with POs, engineers, and researchers, using influence to elevate UX solutions and challenge broader assumptions within internal product teams.- Mentor and coach designers in creating user experiences demonstrating pride in craft, clarity, and effectiveness.- Create UX/UI flows and experiences that elegantly address complex enterprise problems with delightful, user-centric solutions.- Facilitate clear communication across teams, leveraging structured storytelling methods to amplify your impact.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.What you’ll bring- 4+ years of product design experience, particularly within enterprise or B2B contexts.- Proven track record in applying structured service design methodologies such as Definition Sprints, AS-IS/TO-BE mapping, and Service Blueprinting.- Additional experience leading projects, mentoring, or directly managing design team members.- A portfolio demonstrating impactful, user-centered enterprise experiences and a high level of craft.- Expertise in visual design, interaction design, UX writing, and UI design.- Mastery of Figma and familiarity with relevant prototyping and service design tools.- Excellent communication skills in English, capable of articulating complex concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.What we offerElevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.- Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.- Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.- Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.- Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.- Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Expertenkenntnisse: User Experience Design

jobs.occupation: Senior Electronics PCB & ECAD Design Engineer - RF & Mixed Signal (m/f/d) (Forschungs- und Entwicklungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description: RoleHive Robotics is building Europe’s first full-stack orchestration platform for unmanned systems: connecting, controlling, and commanding multi-vendor drone and robot swarms. Our RF communication systems are Made in Germany, deployed on active frontlines, and targeting a highly valued tactical communication market with zero sovereign alternatives today.As our Senior Electronics Hardware Engineer, you own our electronic designs end to end: from requirements through schematic capture, PCB layout, and manufacturing release to bring-up and debugging. You take a hardware requirement and independently turn it into a robust, manufacturable PCB assembly, spot problems early, and keep projects moving without waiting for direction. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. Most importantly, you enjoy designing hardware yourself and seeing it ship. You report into our CTO organization.Bring-up, rework, and close work with mechanical, firmware, and production happen hands-on in our Munich office, so we expect you on site most days of the week.ResponsibilitiesSchematic & PCB Design- Own electronic hardware designs from requirements to manufacturing release, including schematics and design reviews- Select components based on performance, availability, lifecycle, cost, and manufacturability- Place and route multilayer boards, and define stack-ups, design rules, controlled-impedance requirements, and layout constraints- Review designs for manufacturability, reliability, EMC, signal and power integrity, and thermal behavior where relevant- Design with certification in mind: support EMC and radio (CE/RED) pre-compliance and certification testing with external labs, and feed the findings back into the designECAD Libraries & Engineering Data- Create and maintain schematic symbols, footprints, padstacks, and ECAD libraries- Define and maintain electrical, physical, and manufacturing design rule sets- Keep engineering data clean: design documentation, revision history, and versioning that let anyone pick up a design later and improve it- Improve engineering workflows and automate repetitive tasks where it pays offManufacturing & Supply- Generate, review, and release manufacturing outputs and technical documentation- Work directly with PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly partners on stack-ups, fabrication constraints, assembly guidelines, and production requirements- Review BOMs and qualify alternative components based on availability, lifecycle, and technical requirements, together with Operations- Make sure designs scale from prototype runs to serial production volumesBring-up, Test & Integration- Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including burn-in testing, soldering, and rework- Work closely with mechanical and embedded firmware engineers through design, integration, and bring-up- Reproduce and qualify hardware issues from production and the field so they get fixed at the root cause- Handle sensitive and export-controlled design data in line with our dual-use export control requirementsRequirementsYou do not need to tick every box or master every topic from day one. If the core is there and you have the drive to grow into the rest, we want to hear from you.Must Have- 5+ years of professional experience in electronic hardware and PCB development- Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, or a comparable technical foundation- A track record of independently taking PCBs from schematic to manufacturing release: boards you designed that went into production- Strong schematic design and component selection skills, working confidently from datasheets- Strong PCB layout skills on multilayer and high-density boards, including blind and buried vias, built on a solid understanding of grounding, power distribution, differential interfaces, controlled impedance, and high-speed design- Practical understanding of PCB fabrication and PCBA assembly, including direct work with manufacturers on stack-ups, fabrication rules, assembly requirements, and production issues- Hands-on lab skills: board bring-up, debugging, lab equipment, soldering, and rework- Strong experience in at least one professional ECAD environment, such as Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, Siemens Xpedition, or comparable. - Ownership mindset: you drive designs forward without continuous supervision, and an undocumented design change is a problem for you, not a shortcut- Fluent English (German is a plus)- Willingness to undergo security vetting where projects require it- Based in Munich or willing to relocateNice to Have- Cadence OrCAD/Allegro, which our existing products are built on- Experience with BOM management or component lifecycle tools- RF and wireless electronics or communication systems, the core of what we build- Ethernet and high-speed digital interfaces, power electronics, or embedded systems- EMC/EMI-conscious design and experience taking products through EMC and radio certification (CE/RED)- Electronics for robotics, UAVs, or other ruggedized systems, ideally in defense, aerospace, or another regulated environment- Connector selection, wiring harness, and pinout definition- Scripting or engineering automationAbout usWe work in deep-tech and dual-use technology, an industry where women and other underrepresented groups have historically had limited access. We encourage you to apply even if you don't check every box below.Why Hive- Build sovereign technology that matters. We build RF communication and orchestration systems for unmanned platforms across air, land, sea, and space, at a moment when European technological sovereignty is a real strategic question, not an abstract one.- Real ownership, real deployment. Our products are already in serial production and in the field. What you build ships, and you see the result.- Small team, direct access. Around 30 people. You'll work directly with founders and not through multiple layers of management.- You shape the foundations. We're still building the structures, career paths, controlling, compliance, that let a fast-growing company scale well. You'll help decide what they look like.- Modern Munich office, with the tools and equipment to do your best work.What You Get- Compensation. We benchmark salaries to stay competitive for the market and the role, not just what an early-stage budget can spare.- Equity. You participate in Hive through equity/VSOP, a genuine stake in what we build, not just a paycheck.- A role you shape, not one you're handed. We're too early for fixed job descriptions or a career ladder. What you own grows as you take on more, not by climbing steps someone else defined.- No bureaucracy. Small, flat team. Decisions happen in a conversation, not a sign-off chain.Compensation and equity terms vary by role and level.Hive Robotics is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications regardless of race, ethnic origin, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, or marital status. Please don't include data on ethnic origin, political views, religious beliefs, union membership, health, or sexual orientation in your application.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Leiterplatten-Designsysteme (PCB-Design)
